title: AIP-3: Gate A for revision 10
means: Gate A for AIP-3's revision 10, after spec review round 6, whose findings it all answers. Checkpoint 1 builds the read verbs. Checkpoint 2 opens with the one migration (every doc into brain/, flat hash ids, ids.json) and builds the door for writes on that final shape. Checkpoint 3 builds the reflection and the link graph. Checkpoint 4 builds brain's MCP server (D-72). The brain skill is a real Claude Code skill written by brain index.

supersedes.what: D-68's approval held only if round 6 was clean; it was not, and this approves revision 10 itself.
